domain: Applying epidemiological 'outbreak curve' modeling to the spread of wildcat labor strikes across a supply chain
topic: Applying epidemiological 'outbreak curve' modeling to the spread of wildcat labor strikes across a supply chain

movement.gist: A labor researcher imports the SIR (susceptible-infected-recovered) epidemic model to explain a 2019-2023 wave of wildcat strikes rippling outward from a single auto-parts plant through a continent-spanning supply chain; the model's 'basic reproduction number' R0 is proposed as a way to quantify how strike-prone a workforce is.

The model fits beautifully: strike incidence across dozens of plants traces a textbook epidemic curve, complete with an identifiable 'patient zero' plant and a calculable R0 > 1, seemingly proving that strikes truly do spread by contact — worker-to-worker transmission of a contagious disposition to walk out, exactly like a virus.

But the fit was achieved at the wrong level: the model was validated against the AGGREGATE curve shape, while its causal claim operates at the level of INDIVIDUAL worker contact — and closer plant-level data shows strikes erupting at sites with no contact history to 'patient zero' at all, driven instead by identical grievances (pay, safety) accumulating independently and igniting on parallel timelines that only look like transmission when smoothed into a curve.

The epidemiological lens still earns its keep — it forecasts scale and tempo no other model does — but the price is a wrong story about causation; you get the curve and lose the cause, and the two cannot be had together.

primary.axis: whether strikes propagate like contagion (person-to-person transmission) or like ignition (independent combustion at pre-loaded sites)
poles: strikes as social contagion spreading through contact networks
strikes as simultaneous ignition of independently accumulated grievance

secondary.axis: whether the epidemiological lens describes the spread mechanism or merely the shape of the resulting curve
poles: the lens as causal model of transmission
the lens as a descriptive shape imposed after the fact

tension_system.interaction: the secondary tension is what lets the primary tension's decoy (contagion) survive as long as it does — the curve-fit looks like transmission-proof until the level confusion is exposed

family_realization.note: Passage perfectly executes lens arc: epidemiology imported, yields genuine fit (R₀=1.7, residual), then disaggregation reveals distortion (nine contactless sites). Ends on price: forecasting accuracy purchased with false mechanism. Difficulty of tracking lens-use vs. lens-examination evident throughout—author concedes, then dismantles.

ending_behavior.note: 'or not, at any rate, on the evidence currently in hand' refuses synthesis (contagion+ignition impossible) with explicit reason (incompatible claims about same plants). Aperture 'holds'—keeps curve, discards cause. Resolution costed: forecasting power orphaned from explanation.

voice_consistency.note: Spatial/flow metaphors dominate (edges, conduits, thresholds, accumulations reaching threshold). Agents rarely subjects. One stubborn particular: 'break-room, shared shuttle route, union hall two towns over.' Slightly uneven: opening is ceremonial; disaggregation paragraph denser. Avoids generic AI-essay rhythm.

distractor_efficiency.note: Q1(A): scope_inflation trap—reader overgeneralizes 'nine plants' to methodological ban. Q2(C): stage_misattribution—treats concession as conclusion. Q3(C): adjacent_answer—overlapping rotation explicitly listed as absent. Q4(B): missing_link—confuses 'shared grievance' with 'contact restored.' Q6(A): causal_inversion. Q8(A): documented channels. All catch legitimate confusions.

explanation_quality.note: Every wrong option tied to specific mechanisms or location: 'small residual is property of aggregate fit, not disaggregated plants'; 'overlapping rotation explicitly listed absent'; 'paragraph 4 insists apparatus not discardable'; 'no contact channel dissolves level mismatch.' Zero 'not mentioned' explanations. Precise and localized.

answers.reasoning: Matches passage's split: predictions stand, causal mechanism fails at nine plants.
'not, at any rate, on the evidence currently in hand' implies future evidence could change verdict.
Directly stated: no contact channel, but shared frozen pay schedule and safety regime.
Finding actual links would restore contagion explanation, undermining ignition argument.
Author distinguishes fit quality from causal licensing—discriminating about inferential weight.
Independent accumulations reaching threshold separately mimic contagion curve when smoothed.
Statistics build the strongest case before the argument turns to critique it.
Unconnected sites with independently maturing grievances mirrors the ignition account exactly.
